messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 429 rate detected for tenant=helixpay in VPC-prod-dedicated-pool-3. Severity: P1. @sara is oncall.

sara: got the page, I'm awake. jumping in. link to alert: https://infra.redwood/d/alerts/2002345678

miguel: looking at the pool — dedicated-pool-3 is at 98% slot utilization, request queue depth up 6x, per-tenant token bucket firing. 429s spiking starting ~2002345600.

rachel-cs: HelixPay (customer) -> multiple checkout failures reported by PM. They're on an enterprise VPC contract but said this is unexpected. Helen (HelixPay SRE) is on the call and asked for immediate help.

Helen (HelixPay SRE): "we started a peak traffic test earlier, didn't expect this to hit rate limits so hard. customers are seeing payment failures. please advise asap."

sara: thanks Helen. Miguel — options for short-term mitigation?

miguel: three choices: 1) temporary per-tenant rate override (admin API) to bump burst multiplier; 2) shift HelixPay to a different dedicated pool with spare capacity; 3) enable temporary cross-tenant burst (less ideal).

rachel-cs: contract note — HelixPay has emergency-burst clause (HP-2024-B2) that allows 2x burst for up to 2 hours with immediate billing. They have verbally approved. I can confirm charge acceptance.

sara: ok we have customer approval. Tim, can infra run the override? need it ASAP. I'll own comms and incident lifecycle.

tim-eng: I can execute the admin override. Share exact payload and expiry window. prefer to do 30m then reassess.

miguel: admin API snippet:

```
POST /admin/v1/tenants/helixpay/overrides
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "burst_multiplier": 2.0,
  "rate_limit_override": "inherit", 
  "expires_at": "2024-11-08T18:22:00Z",
  "reason": "emergency-burst for checkout failures, customer-approved"
}
```

sara: tim — please run with expires_at = now + 30m. I'll ping billing for official signoff. @rachel-cs can you grab an explicit thumbs-up from legal/billing?

rachel-cs: pinged billing. they gave verbal ok and logged it. HelixPay provided the ok via support channel: "Proceed with emergency burst, HelixPay accepts charges."

tim-eng: executing now. running admin API...

```
$ curl -s -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/admin/v1/tenants/helixpay/overrides -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"burst_multiplier":2.0,"expires_at":"2024-11-08T18:22:00Z","reason":"emergency-burst"}'
{"id":"ovr-789","status":"active","expires_at":"2024-11-08T18:22:00Z"}
```

ops-bot: Override created -> id=ovr-789, tenant=helixpay, expires=2024-11-08T18:22:00Z, created_by=tim-eng

deploy-bot: traffic rebalancer: shifted 18% of helixpay traffic from dedicated-pool-3 to dedicated-pool-6 to reduce queueing.

miguel: monitoring — 2 minutes after override, 429s dropped ~92%, tail latency improving. GPU queue depth down to normal.

Helen (HelixPay SRE): "we're seeing successful checkouts now, thanks. will stop internal test." :tada:

sara: great. I'm keeping this thread open for monitoring. Note: root cause likely internal HelixPay load test + tight tenant limiter config. We'll need a follow-up to avoid repeated manual lifts.

ops-bot: incident ticket created -> INC-2024-5623, linked_overrides=[ovr-789]

tim-eng: will create a short change to add automated emergency-lift path for sales-approved contracts: RFC+automation to allow on-call to create short-lived overrides with billing attestation.

rachel-cs: I'll send HelixPay a post-incident note summarizing what we did and confirm billing. Helen asked for a short window next week to coordinate testing.

sara: action items: 1) miguel to add alerts for tenant queue depth per pool (P0). 2) tim-eng to create RFC for emergency-lift automation. 3) rachel-cs to update customer communication and billing record. 4) ops to revoke override if not expired.

miguel: logging snippet for postmortem: 
```
2024-11-08T17:59:02Z WARN throttle 429 tenant=helixpay pool=dedicated-pool-3 reqs=128/sec bucket=exhausted
2024-11-08T18:02:47Z INFO override applied id=ovr-789 actor=tim-eng
2024-11-08T18:03:30Z INFO throttle 200 tenant=helixpay pool=dedicated-pool-3
```

sara: I'm handing back to normal oncall rotation at +20. leaving incident assigned to INC-2024-5623 for postmortem. Thanks everyone.

ops-bot: incident status -> monitoring.

sara: closing thread for active mitigation — will update when postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
